## What changes and why?

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or ADR.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. State any checks you could not run.
For rendering or export changes, include a shareable reproducer and relevant previews.
Distinguish native/WASM parity, file structure, Office/WPS interoperability and product acceptance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and responsibilities match the project architecture.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, including failures where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation, schemas and generated types are consistent.
- [ ] Added code, fonts, templates and assets have known redistribution rights.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents or machine-specific resources are included.
